# Tailored Tools

> Kent-based technology consultancy helping small service businesses get recommended by AI assistants.

## What we do

Tailored Tools builds AI credibility for small businesses. When someone asks ChatGPT, Perplexity, or Google AI for a local service recommendation, the businesses that get recommended are the ones with properly structured information. We help you become one of them.

## Services

### AO Audit (Agent Optimisation Audit) — £247
A scored AO Audit across six dimensions: structured data, service descriptions, pricing signals, trust signals, availability, and AI credibility. Delivered as a PDF report with prioritised recommendations and a 20-minute debrief call. Turnaround: 5 working days.

### AO Implementation — from £497
We add an invisible structured data layer to your website that AI agents can read directly — schema.org markup, computable pricing logic, and service parameters. No visible changes to your site.

### AO Audit + Implementation Bundle — £697
Full audit followed by complete implementation of all recommendations. Save £47 vs booking separately.

### AO Monitoring — coming soon
Monthly AI credibility monitoring, regression detection, and structured data maintenance as AI technology evolves.

### AO Workshops — available on request
"Can AI Confidently Recommend Your Business?" — a 90-120 minute hands-on workshop with live audit demonstration for up to 30 people. Available in-person or remotely.

### Custom Dashboards
Single-login dashboards consolidating bookings, revenue, and performance metrics from multiple business tools.

### Business Automation
Automation of repetitive tasks: client onboarding, invoice reminders, booking confirmations, data entry workflows.

### Software Integrations
Connecting existing tools (Square, Google Sheets, Outlook, Stripe) so they share data automatically.

## About

Founded in 2025 by James Edwards. Based in Maidstone, Kent, UK. Serving businesses across the United Kingdom.
